entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return this helmet I bought. This is my third time calling. Get it done or get me a manager.
I'm very sorry to hear about your frustration, sir. I can definitely look into that return for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yeah, it's VF88602. It's the Urban Commuter Helmet. I want my money back immediately.
Okay, I'm pulling up order VF88602 now. To make sure I'm addressing this correctly, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
The color is completely wrong! It looked charcoal on your website but it's practically light gray. It's hideous. I'm not wearing it.
I see. I apologize that the color wasn't what you expected. I see the order was delivered to you about 30 days ago. Just one moment while I check the return eligibility.

Don't give me the runaround! I know your policy. The box is unopened. It's in perfect condition. If you don't take this back, I'll write a review on every single website about your terrible service and misleading photos.

There's no need for that, sir. I've just confirmed our policy. You are well within the 90-day return window for a standard item like this. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you. Our main goal is your satisfaction and safety, and we want you to feel confident in the gear you wear.
Fine. About time. So what happens now?

I am sending a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on file right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, your refund will be processed.
Alright. I got the email. See that it gets done.
We certainly will. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
